installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Image to install with is 'ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian'

##
#
# Variables
# STEAM_USER, STEAM_PASS, STEAM_AUTH - Steam user setup. If a user has 2fa enabled it will most likely fail due to timeout. Leave blank for anon install.
# WINDOWS_INSTALL - if it's a windows server you want to install set to 1
# SRCDS_APPID - steam app id found here - https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Dedicated_Servers_List
# SRCDS_BETAID - beta branch of a steam app. Leave blank to install normal branch
# SRCDS_BETAPASS - password for a beta branch should one be required during private or closed testing phases.. Leave blank for no password.
# INSTALL_FLAGS - Any additional SteamCMD  flags to pass during install.. Keep in mind that steamcmd auto update process in the docker image might overwrite or ignore these when it performs update on server boot.
# AUTO_UPDATE - Adding this variable to the egg allows disabling or enabling automated updates on boot. Boolean value. 0 to disable and 1 to enable.
#


## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit ## other flags may be needed depending on install. looking at you cs 1.6

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

cd /mnt/server
rm start-server.sh

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The internal server name used for save/ config files.

variables.name: Steam Beta Branch [requires reinstall]
variables.description: Beta branch to install, such as b41multiplayer. Leave blank to install normal branch

variables.name: Steam Auto Update
variables.description: Enable or disable auto-update on startup. 0 to disable and 1 to enable.

variables.name: [System] Steam Workshop App ID
variables.description: The Steam app ID Workshop items browsed/added via the Workshop extension belong to. This is the base GAME's app ID, NOT the dedicated server's app ID above - confirmed live via the Steam Web API's consumer_app_id field on real, current Project Zomboid Workshop items. Rarely needs to be changed.

variables.name: [System] Steam Workshop Storage Mode
variables.description: Where the Workshop extension should read/write this server's mod list. Project Zomboid has no MODIFICATIONS-style egg variable - its dedicated server reads its own WorkshopItems list from a plain ini file, downloading anything listed there itself on every boot. Rarely needs to be changed.

variables.name: [System] Steam Workshop Ini Directory
variables.description: Directory (relative to the server root) containing the ini file the Workshop extension should edit. Project Zomboid always keeps its per-server config under Zomboid/Server. Rarely needs to be changed.

variables.name: [System] Steam Workshop Ini Name Variable
variables.description: The name of the OTHER variable on this egg whose current value is the ini file's base name (Project Zomboid names its config "<server name>.ini", e.g. the "Server Name" variable above). Rarely needs to be changed.

variables.name: [System] Steam Workshop Ini Items Key
variables.description: The ini key the Workshop extension should add/remove Workshop item IDs from. Rarely needs to be changed.

variables.name: [System] Steam Workshop Ini Mods Key
variables.description: The ini key holding the SEPARATE list of mod.info IDs to actually load (Project Zomboid's Mods=) - distinct from the Workshop ID list above, since a Workshop item's internal mod ID can't be looked up via the Steam Web API. Leave blank if this egg has no such key. Rarely needs to be changed.

variables.name: [System] Server Query Protocol
variables.description: Which query protocol the Player Count extension should use to fetch live online/max player counts for this server ("minecraft" for Minecraft's Server List Ping, "source" for the Source-engine A2S protocol). Set by the egg, not the server owner.

variables.name: Steam API Key
variables.description: Your own Steam Web API key for searching the Workshop, so you're not sharing the panel-wide key/quota. Leave blank to use the panel's own key instead. Get one free at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey.
